relationship_to_historical_target: Corrective extension retains numeric builtins outside frozen kinetic-core-v0.1 target. Does not establish full target or language conformance.

rational_contract.representation: Typed unreduced signed numerator/denominator; preserve rational AST distinct from division.
rational_contract.recognition: Reference primary canonical precision15 and plain signed integer spelling below1e15, in complete parentheses; plus-sign and separately grouped operands escape rational tokenization.
rational_contract.components: Final normalized numerator and denominator must each lie in inclusive signed32-bit range; wider safe intermediates allow unary signs to fold before final validation.
rational_contract.call_open: A rational numeric token consumed by the opening function delimiter is a syntax error, not a call argument.
rational_contract.zero_denominator: Explicit UnsupportedFeature in every rational context; ordinary division rates retain their existing contract.
rational_contract.dimensions: Rational numeric atom is dimensionless; ordinary numeric literal dimensional inference remains unchanged.
